paragraphs.text:
Of course, you must return to Fort McDonald. But there is 
time for one last side trip, in hopes of learning a little more 
about the North Hanninah Valley.

If you still have all your companions, go to 602.
If you have all three graduate students with you, but not Charlie, 
go to 158.
If you have Norman, Sylvia, and Charlie with you, go to 598.
If you have two companions, go to 324.
If you have one companion, go to 279.
If you are alone, go to 597.
